questions: Does kd near 0.2 at this geometry lower slalom steering_oscillation below 0.16 without losing progress?
Does any controller change move line_loss_events below one on the oval or s-bend, or max_error below 0.06 m?
Do the metrics match iteration 9 (36.6227) to four decimals? If so, geometry and the current controller are both exhausted, and I will record that for the final iteration.
Please report per-step telemetry for one trial per track: the step and progress where the first line loss begins, and whether it occurs at the start or at a specific bend.

intent: Freeze geometry at the iteration 9 best-scoring platform (score 36.6227): ±0.04 m 16 mm row at y = 0.07 m, wheel_track 0.10 m, mass 0.8 kg, wheel_radius 0.03 m, body 0.12 × 0.18 m. Let the Integrator test controller damping (kd near 0.2) on this platform to address the slalom oscillation and the single line loss on the oval and s-bend. I expect the geometry-level metrics to stay at the iteration 9 values, and any change to come from the controller.
learning: Iteration 9 shows wheel_track 0.10 m helps the slalom at kp 3.0 and leaves the oval and s-bend unchanged. Geometry has now been tested across spread, footprint, track, radius, lead and mass without changing the line-loss outcome on the oval and s-bend. The next evidence should come from controller damping. If kd does not change the oval and s-bend, the final iteration should keep this geometry and make only the smallest justified change, because the remaining lever is the controller rather than the body.
rationale: Iteration 9 is the best design so far at 36.6227. It keeps the ±0.04 m, 16 mm row at y = 0.07 m, mass 0.8 kg and wheel_radius 0.03 m, and narrows wheel_track from 0.12 to 0.10 m. The gain over iteration 8 (36.3097) came only from the slalom: max_error rose to 0.0681 m from 0.0694 m, steering_oscillation eased to 0.1611 from 0.1627, and the slalom score rose to 46.12 from 45.18. The oval and s-bend metrics did not change at all (max_error 0.0614 and 0.0611 m, one line-loss event per trial, no finishes). Across spread, footprint, track, radius, lead and mass, the line-loss mechanism on the oval and s-bend has not moved. The off-track floor of 0.06 m is still binding, and body width cannot lift it. Geometry therefore looks exhausted for the line-loss problem. The Integrator's feedback asks me to re-test wheel_track 0.10 m on the ±0.04 m row. That is exactly the iteration 9 design, which has already raced, so I am not repeating it as a new test. I hold the iteration 9 geometry as the platform for the controller work. Narrowing further (for example to 0.09 m) would push slalom steering_oscillation toward the 0.16 threshold for little expected gain, and the final track is unseen, so a stable platform is worth more than a marginal slalom gain. The remaining lever is controller damping (kd near 0.2), which belongs to the Integrator.
